Gods & Worship
Collect God Souls, build shrines and use a Priest Rod.
Spell List
Look up soul costs, cooldowns and casting notes.
Collect a God Soul
Finish a God Soul source with a Saronite Sword while carrying a bottle.
Prepare the sword and bottle

Craft a Saronite Sword and carry an empty glass bottle. Use the sword for the killing strike on an Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian or summoned god avatar.\
\
Each successful harvest fills one bottle. Arrows cannot collect God Souls. Without a bottle, no soul is left behind.
Choose what to make

One God Soul lets you create a god at a Deity Fabricator. Five are needed for a Ring of Power: four on plinths and one offered at the Infusion Table.\
\
God Souls cannot enter a Soul Well, work in machines or be extracted with a Bone Cage. You can worship another player’s god without making one.

Your animated ally

The ally follows you and fights nearby hostiles or creatures you fight. It avoids you, your pets and your other allies. It lasts three minutes.\
\
Summoned creatures cannot be caged or harvested for souls. The spell's three-minute cooldown limits repeated summons.
